string.text: We lost %s. All groups, move out and take it back.
Shelling! Mortars are hitting %s, it's %s. Take cover!
Their battery is at %s. Counter-battery fire!
We're pinned at %s! Nearest groups, help us!
Thanks, friend. I won't forget this.
Wave after wave on %s! No retreat!
They're throwing waves at %s! It's %s. Hold!
Groups moving to the flanks of %s. Pincer.
They're encircling %s! It's %s. Don't let them close the ring!
Cauldron at %s: the %s garrison is cut off.
Laying siege to %s. Battery, open up.
%s is under siege! It's %s. Expect shelling.
Tonight small groups slip into %s. Quietly.
Movement at %s: small groups sneaking in, it's %s!
Truce: %s and %s are tired of burying their own.
Trade deal: %s and %s swap guns for medicine.
Betrayal! %s and %s are allies no more.
The war between %s and %s is heating up.
We're pinned at %s! Anyone near, help!
Sending a group to %s. Hold on!
Our convoy is passing %s. Cover it if you're near.
Everyone: Monolith is breaking through to %s!
A crowd of zombified is shambling to %s.
The army is sweeping %s. Stay out of the way.
We set up a checkpoint at %s.
Help! Near %s, %s are after me for a debt!
Talks: envoys of %s and %s meet at %s.
Assassination at %s! The %s and %s talks are off, each blames the other.
Assassination at %s! The %s and %s envoys were attacked, the trail leads to %s.
The attempt at %s was foiled. %s and %s trust each other more now.
Our people are held at %s by %s! Anyone near, get them out!
Deserters went towards %s. Find them and bring them back!
Wounded near %s, no medkits... Anyone, help...
Thanks, you saved me. Here, %s RU.
Intercept: a man ran from %s and wants to give himself up. Seen near %s.
A science team is taking measurements at %s. Please cover them.
The scientists at %s are under attack! Help!
Measurements at %s are done. Thanks to everyone who covered us.
The science team at %s is not answering. I fear the worst.
Their commander is down. They're wavering!
Intercept: %s is calling mortars on you! Move!
A prisoner from %s got away. Nobody was watching.
The job fell through. Refunded: %s RU.
%s notes: an operation on %s is being prepared, %s.
Mutants from a lair nearby are heading for %s!
Mutants are spreading: a new nest at %s.
A controller is driving zombies at %s!
%s pays %s RU for clearing the lair at %s.
The lair at %s is cleared. Bounty paid.
After the emission the packs are on the move. Seen near %s.
The alpha is down, the pack scatters!
A man-eater at %s: a beast that has taken people leads the pack.
Got it. Off hunting at the lair near %s.
Got it. We'll search the anomalies near %s.
Got it. We'll watch them from %s.
Got it. Going for supplies at %s.
Got it. We'll knock them off %s.
We're back. Nothing came of it at %s.
Back from the hunt at %s. Got: %s. It's in my pack.
We wiped out the lair at %s. Got: %s.
We're back. Brought: %s. It's in my pack.
%s's squad isn't answering. Looks like they're gone.
Nowhere suitable nearby. We stay with you.
Can't, they won't let us go now. We stay.
Enough of us are out already. We stay.
Word is %s hunters wiped out the lair at %s.
Rumour: %s people brought an artefact out of %s.
"%s": the target is dead. Go collect from the client.
"%s": the point is cleared. Report to the client.
"%s": we found it, %s. It's in my pack.
"%s": not all cleared, some are still there.
"%s": we only found part of it, %s.
"%s": didn't work out. Too much for us.
"%s": that job is over already. Coming back.
We can't take that one on: there's nothing to go after.
%s's squad never came back. Word is they left with the loot.
I've got a job for you.
Go hunting at the nearest lair.
Look for artefacts in the anomalies.
Get supplies from a base. Here's the money.
Knock the enemy off the nearest point.
Will do. We'll find you when we're done.
Take care of one of my jobs for me.
Stop, thief! He ran off with the loot towards %s!
You're being hunted: %s won't forgive the killing.
Intercept: %s put a price on your head. Hunters are on your trail.
Intercept: a %s courier is carrying orders to %s.
Someone saw you pick up an artefact. %s are coming after you.
Intercept: %s are going after %s, who found an artefact.
%s and %s met on the road and traded.
%s and %s quarrelled on the road and went for their guns.
Envoys of %s and %s set out for talks at %s.
The wounded %s man at %s died waiting for help.
The wounded %s man at %s was saved.
A %s squad went for artefacts at %s.
A %s squad went for supplies at %s.
A %s squad moved on %s to clear it.
A trader is open: %s at %s. Serves %s.
A %s with guards is on the road to %s. Serves %s.
Rumour has it a %s of %s is about.
Intercept: %s are going to rob the trader at %s.
Thanks, you saved my goods. Take %s RU.
Trader %s at %s was saved from robbers.
I only trade with %s. Move along.
I trade with %s and their friends. You're neither.
I don't trade with enemies of %s.
A strike costs %s RU. Not enough money.
Request received. Target: %s, shells in %s min.
This faction is not at war right now.
Strength rank: %s of %s Points: %s, bases: %s Squads: %s
Your fire orders (right-click a point on the map): %s RU, %s
Rumours of %s more traders, nobody knows where.
The players' people: companions and hired men
Holding %s of %s points, dug in at %s.
%s are properly dug in at %s now.
The supply run to %s never made it. The post is running dry.
%s post here: %s coming at us! Anyone near, get over here!
The post at %s has gone silent. The garrison is gone.
%s: %s is a %s again, short of men and supplies.
%s is fortified now: trenches, stores, our own people.
%s went to cut off the supply run to %s.
I've got a job. Will you take it, for pay?
Too much. Come down a bit.
I don't have that kind of money.
You've got men out on jobs already. Settle with them first.
We won't take that: there's nothing to go after.
Can't, they won't let us go now.
Fine. %s, and not a coin less.
Done. Wait for word on the radio.
"%s": the target is dead. Go collect from the client.
"%s": the point is cleared. Report to the client.
"%s": found it and sent it to you: %s.
"%s": not all cleared, some are still there.
"%s": we only found part of it, sent you: %s.
"%s": didn't work out. You'll get part of the money back.
Paid back for a job that fell through: %s RU.
%s and his men vanished with what they found for "%s".
%s's squad, hired for "%s", has gone off the air.
Zone Frontline settings. In co-op the host's apply; the other player sees them here, locked. Changes apply at once.
Counter-attacks, night raids, assaults, artillery, morale, reinforcements and fire orders from the map.
Every point a faction holds keeps a squad: it digs in, gets supply runs, is relieved and calls for help.
Surrender, prisoners, rewards, executions, rescues and escapes.
Events between factions. Active when dynamic relations are on in the A-Life options.
Random encounters around the players; delegations, prisoners, deserters, wounded, defectors, scientists.
Commanders, radiomen, medics, snipers, assault troopers, grenadiers, sappers.
Nests, alphas and man-eaters, migrations after an emission, psi waves, scavengers.
NPCs go about their own business; companions can be sent on jobs or on your tasks.
Road meetings, trade and tolls, chases, avengers, thieves, couriers, robbers.
Travelling traders: sixteen trades, three kinds of shop, their own customers and guards.
This computer only: in co-op everyone has their own.
Turn it off and Zone Frontline stops acting. Saves are not harmed.
PDA messages also about levels with no players.
With this many NPCs around, the mod brings no more. Lower = higher FPS.
A squad the second player hires follows them and takes their orders.
Quickly sets the chances and pauses below. Pick one and press Apply.
A faction that lost a point tries to take it back.
Silent hits on weakly held enemy points.
How often factions storm enemy bases.
Game hours before a faction storms again.
How many squads one assault may gather.
Mortar strikes by factions with mortars.
Game hours before the same faction fires again.
A squad falls back when this share of it is left. 0 = never.
How many squads answer a call for help.
The host can order a mortar strike: right-click a point or squad on the PDA map.
What a strike costs; 30% less if your faction has mortars.
Game hours before the next order.
How many shells one order brings.
Base chance a wounded man gives up; rank, discipline, gear and odds change it.
Below this share of health an NPC considers giving up.
Multiplies the money for a prisoner.
How often cruel factions shoot prisoners. 0 = never.
His own may come for a prisoner.
A prisoner left unwatched may run.
How often diplomacy checks for an event.
Ambushes, patrols, caravans and other scenes nearby.
How many may run at once.
Delegations, prisoners, deserters, wounded, defectors, scientists.
Chance someone tries to wreck the talks.
How often the wounded man event comes up. 0 = never.
How often a defector comes up. 0 = never.
How often the scientists come up. 0 = never.
Roles come from gear, rank and squad, and not everyone has one.
Damage to an assault trooper is multiplied by this.
How many tripwires a sapper keeps out.
Chance a radioman calls a strike.
Chance a squad with no radioman still gets help.
Nests, alphas, migrations, psi waves, scavengers.
How often a nest sends a pack at the posts nearby.
How many nest-bred packs live at once.
Chance a pack follows an alpha.
Damage to an alpha is multiplied by this.
A mutant that killed this many people leads its pack. 0 = off.
How many packs move after an emission.
Chance mutants come to a recent battlefield.
Base bounty for a big nest, more per level.
NPCs run errands; companions can be sent on jobs or your tasks.
How many squads run errands at once.
How many companions can be out at once.
Game hours a squad has before it counts as lost.
Chance a squad coming back with loot is attacked.
A find worth more than this may tempt a greedy companion to keep it.
Road meetings, trade, tolls, chases, avengers, couriers, robbers.
Real minutes before the same two squads stop to talk again.
A routed squad or an escaped prisoner gets chased.
How far a player must run after a killing to be chased.
Chance hunters come after you for a commander.
Chance a thief runs past with his loot.
Chance a faction sends a courier.
Chance bandits nearby go after whoever picked up an artefact.
Traders turn up in the Zone, stay at a point a while and move on.
How many travelling traders at once.
Chance a trader is announced and marked on the PDA; the rest you find yourself.
Game hours at one point, roughly.
Chance bandits try to rob a rich trader near the players (checked every 10 s).
One squad of the owner always stays on a point.
How many of a faction's squads may sit on posts; the rest fight.
Extra squads a grown post keeps: strongpoint +1, fortified area +2, front +1.
Chance the enemy sends a squad after a supply run.
A developed post with buildings draws a trader: its side's own or a free one.
How many post traders at once.
Chance the trader who comes is a free one.
Holes are manned first, no new ground a side can't hold, new ground at the edge of its own.
How far from its own points a side takes new ground.
Game hours per level of digging in (three levels).
Extra offline battle strength per level.
Game hours before a fresh squad relieves the garrison.
Posts away from bases need supply runs; a lost one weakens the post.
Game hours one supply run lasts.
Encounter, event and trader people don't die before the players see them.
Share of NPC and mutant damage they take while unseen.
Any squad leader of your side can be hired for one of your tasks; the price is the man's own.
Leaders of friendly factions can be hired too, for more.
How many hired squads one player can have out at once.
Chance a trader deals with anyone at all, even his side's enemies.
How many squads a faction may have; its bases spawn no more at the cap. Lower = fewer NPCs. 0 = no cap.
A faction goes back to its starting bases: an empty one is manned again, one taken by an enemy is retaken.
Encounters and events show on the PDA map and the minimap.
Base respawn at least every, min
WALO stretches a big faction's respawn up to x200 its minimum. This caps it, in game minutes. 0 = as WALO.
[ZF] lines in the game log. Only for hunting bugs.
